spec.title: Connections by Database
spec.description: Current backend connections per database. Useful for spotting the busiest databases on the selected server.

spec.title: Longest Active Transaction
spec.description: Longest currently running active transaction in seconds across all databases on the selected server.

spec.title: Sessions by Wait Event Type
spec.description: Current sessions grouped by PostgreSQL wait-event type. This helps identify whether sessions are waiting on locks, IO, client, or other resources.

spec.title: Commits per Second by Database
spec.description: Top databases by committed transactions per second. Uses the PostgreSQL transaction commit counters.

spec.title: Rollbacks per Second by Database
spec.description: Top databases by rolled-back transactions per second. A rising rollback rate can indicate application errors, contention, or failed work.

spec.title: Cache Hit Ratio by Database
spec.description: Current cumulative cache hit ratio by database since PostgreSQL statistics were last reset. Higher values indicate more reads are being served from shared buffers rather than disk.

spec.title: Disk Blocks Read per Second
spec.description: Top databases by physical block reads per second. Higher values typically indicate more disk-bound activity.

spec.title: Average Read Time per Block
spec.description: Average time spent reading a data block from disk, derived from cumulative PostgreSQL read-time and read-count counters since stats reset.

spec.title: PostgreSQL Up
spec.description: Reports whether the selected PostgreSQL server is reachable by postgres_exporter. A value of 1 means the exporter could connect successfully.

spec.title: Temporary Bytes Written per Second
spec.description: Top databases by temporary file write rate. Large temp usage may indicate sorts, hashes, or queries spilling to disk.

spec.title: Locks by Mode
spec.description: Current number of PostgreSQL locks by lock mode across all non-template databases on the selected server.

spec.title: Locks by Database
spec.description: Databases currently holding the most locks. Useful for spotting databases with elevated concurrency or lock pressure.

spec.title: Deadlocks per Second by Database
spec.description: Rate of deadlocks by database. Any sustained non-zero rate deserves investigation.

spec.title: Largest User Tables
spec.description: Top user tables by current size. This helps identify the largest tables contributing to storage usage.

spec.title: Tables with Most Dead Tuples
spec.description: Top user tables by estimated dead tuples. High values can indicate vacuum lag or heavy churn.

spec.title: Sequential Scans per Second by Table
spec.description: Top user tables by sequential scan rate. Persistent high sequential scan activity can be a signal to review indexing strategy.

spec.title: Server Role
spec.description: Indicates whether the selected PostgreSQL server is acting as a primary or replica.

spec.title: Last Scrape Error
spec.description: Whether the most recent postgres_exporter scrape encountered an error. A value of 0 means the last scrape succeeded.

spec.title: Replication Lag
spec.description: Replication lag behind the upstream server, in seconds. On a primary this is usually 0.

spec.title: Replay Age
spec.description: Age of the last replayed transaction in seconds. Useful when the selected server is a replica.

spec.title: WAL Segments
spec.description: Current number of WAL segments retained on the selected server.

spec.title: Last Scrape Duration
spec.description: Duration of the most recent postgres_exporter scrape against the selected server.

spec.title: Max WAL Size
spec.description: Configured PostgreSQL `max_wal_size` setting for the selected server.

spec.title: Checkpoints per Second
spec.description: Scheduled and requested checkpoint rates. A rise in requested checkpoints can indicate checkpoint pressure or WAL growth.

spec.title: Buffer Writes by Source
spec.description: Estimated write throughput by write source, derived from PostgreSQL background writer and checkpoint buffer counters multiplied by block size.

spec.title: Archiver Activity
spec.description: WAL archiver success and failure rate. Failed archive attempts should remain near zero.

spec.title: WAL Size History
spec.description: Time history of total WAL size retained by PostgreSQL.

spec.title: Active Sessions
spec.description: Current total number of sessions across all databases and connection states on the selected server.

spec.title: Max Connections
spec.description: Configured PostgreSQL `max_connections` setting for the selected server.

spec.title: Shared Buffers
spec.description: Configured PostgreSQL `shared_buffers` setting for the selected server.

spec.title: Work Mem
spec.description: Configured PostgreSQL `work_mem` setting for the selected server.

spec.title: Effective Cache Size
spec.description: Configured PostgreSQL `effective_cache_size` hint for the query planner.

spec.title: Autovacuum
spec.description: Whether PostgreSQL autovacuum is enabled on the selected server.

spec.title: Track IO Timing
spec.description: Whether PostgreSQL is collecting IO timing statistics. This should be enabled to make read and write timing metrics more informative.

spec.title: Collector Success
spec.description: Per-collector success state from postgres_exporter. A value of 1 means the collector completed successfully.

spec.title: Collector Duration
spec.description: Per-collector scrape duration reported by postgres_exporter. Higher values indicate slower collector queries or heavier catalog load.

spec.title: Databases Monitored
spec.description: Number of non-template databases currently exposed by postgres_exporter for the selected server.

spec.title: Total Database Size
spec.description: Combined on-disk size of all non-template databases on the selected server.

spec.title: WAL Size
spec.description: Current total size of write-ahead log (WAL) segments on the selected server.

spec.title: Connections by State
spec.description: Breakdown of current PostgreSQL sessions by activity state such as active, idle, or idle in transaction.

spec.title: Largest Databases
spec.description: Top databases by current on-disk size, excluding template databases.
